presentation.label: SPIRAL
presentation.summary: A tempo-locked delay whose repeats climb or sink in pitch, compounding with every repeat; Glide adds a rise that starts at each note.
presentation.overview: A tempo-locked delay whose repeats climb or sink in pitch, compounding with every repeat; Glide adds a rise that starts at each note.
highlights: Play isolated notes and listen for the repeats to climb or fall as Rise moves through centre.
usage: Add Spiral from the Delay group to a spare patch.
Play isolated notes and listen for the repeats to climb or fall as Rise moves through centre.
Use the page buttons to reach the remaining controls.

controls.name: Div
controls.doc: Musical division of the tempo below: 1/32, 1/16T, 1/16, 1/8T, 1/8, dotted 1/8, 1/4, dotted 1/4. Default 30 lands on 1/16, which at 120 BPM is the 125 ms that the old Time=17 produced. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Tempo
controls.doc: BPM, read straight off the knob so the pedal's own number IS the tempo. Clamped to 40..240 in the DSP. Range 0–240.

controls.name: Feed
controls.doc: Repeats, scaled to 0.965 and soft-clipped in the loop. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Rise
controls.doc: Per-repeat ratio: 0 = octave down, 50 = unity, 100 = octave up. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Glide
controls.doc: Depth of the onset-triggered ramp on that ratio. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Span
controls.doc: How long the rise takes, ~0.19 s .. ~8 s. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Tone
controls.doc: Low-pass inside the feedback loop. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
This build has startup knob initialization disabled. Check saved settings after recalling a patch.
